title: Vertical and horizontal segment estimates for a complex primitive
statement: Let L,y₀∈ℝ satisfy L≥0 and y₀>0. Let F,H:ℂ→ℂ and w:ℝ→ℝ. Suppose H is continuous on {z:Im z>0}, F has complex derivative H(z) at every point of that half-plane, w is continuous on [y₀,∞), and ‖H(z)‖≤w(Im z) whenever 0≤Re z≤L and Im z≥y₀. Then: (i) for every x,y,t∈ℝ with 0≤x≤L and y₀≤y≤t, ‖F(x+it)−F(x+iy)‖≤∫_y^t w(s)ds; and (ii) for every x,y∈ℝ with 0≤x≤L and y≥y₀, ‖F(x+iy)−F(iy)‖≤xw(y). All integrals use real Lebesgue measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (F H : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (L y₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → 0 < y₀ → ContinuousOn H {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt F (H z) z) → ContinuousOn w (Set.Ici y₀) → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ L → y₀ ≤ z.im → ‖H z‖ ≤ w z.im) → (∀ (x y t : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → y₀ ≤ y → y ≤ t → ‖F ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) - F ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ ∫ s in y..t, w s) ∧ (∀ (x y : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → y₀ ≤ y → ‖F ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - F ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ x * w y)
